about: [C8 critic] the poke: in the beat 'gun' (nobody shooting; it waits for E) walk into the room's walls, the counter, the booths, behind the counter, the back of the room; out of the door; down the pavement to the alley, up to the roadworks, across to the el, its stair, under its far side. What stops me, what answers, what is unfinished.
